description: A transparent research SESSION (per ADR-2606131600). shirabe 調べ answered a natural-language question by reading the read-only public web (G1) and grounding a Murakumo-fleet gemma4 answer (G2) in cited sources (G4). The whole session — question, sources, model, answer — is appended to the kotoba Datom log so it can be audited (G5 相互監視). It is a LOOK-UP, never an outward action: no booking, buying, authentication, or form submission. Identity is bound only when a member signed the session (G6); an anonymous session binds none.

sessionId.description: 16-hex content address of (question, started-at) — the shirabe-session entity key.

member.description: The DID of the member who SIGNED this session. Present ONLY when signed (G6); an anonymous research session omits it and binds no identity.

question.description: The member's own natural-language question, verbatim. Carries no profile/behavioural context (G3).

qtype.description: Question type classified by the plan leg.

freshness.description: true = the answer depends on CURRENT state (hours/price/weather/news) and therefore required the live web leg, not a stale snapshot.

model.description: The inference model id, of shape `<model>@<host:port>`. The host MUST be Murakumo-fleet (G2) — LiteLLM 127.0.0.1:4000 / EVO-X2 192.168.1.70:4000 / per-node Ollama 127.0.0.1:11434. A commercial-API host is structurally rejected at persist time.

answer.description: The gemma4 answer, grounded in the sources with inline [n] citations (G4). May be `INSUFFICIENT` when the sources did not suffice (honest non-fabrication).

insufficient.description: true = the model reported the sources were insufficient to answer (surfaced honestly, never papered over with a fabricated answer).

citedSources.description: The source ranks the answer cited, computed on read from the answer's [n] markers (transient; never a stored score).

sources.description: The read-only public-web sources the evidence came from (bounded ≤ top-k, G5). Every source keeps its URL + retrieved-at for provenance.

startedAt.description: The as-of date/time the session ran (injected; resume-safe determinism). For a freshness question this is also the resolved 本日 the answer reasoned against.

url.description: The source URL (the real source, DDG-redirect-unwrapped). Read-only, public.

snippetCid.description: sha256 content address (b-prefixed) of the retrieved snippet — provenance + dedup.

retrievedAt.description: When the snippet was retrieved (injected clock).

query.description: The sub-query that surfaced this source.
